request.description:
Creates a task.

Body: title (required string, at most 255 characters, not empty once markup and whitespace are stripped), description (optional string), field_values (optional array of {field_id, value}; a field_slug sent with them is ignored).

Errors: 400 rest_missing_callback_param (no title), 400 rest_invalid_param (title or description not a string), 400 invalid_data (errors listed per field in data.errors), 500 task_creation_failed, 500 task_created_with_error (the task exists; data.task_id holds its ID, so do not create it again).

request.description:
Sets the task's status to the option that holds the done role. No body.

Errors: 400 invalid_id, 404 not_found, 409 task_finish_failed (no done role is set), 500 task_finish_failed.

Archives the task by setting its archived date. No body.

Errors: 400 invalid_id, 404 not_found, 500 task_archive_failed.

Clears the task's archived date. No body.

Errors: 400 invalid_id, 404 not_found, 500 task_unarchive_failed.

Moves the task into a status column and returns its new position.

Body: target_status_id (required, the ID of a Status field option), previous_task_id (optional, the task to place it after; left out, the task goes first).

Errors: 400 invalid_params (missing IDs, or the target is not a Status option), 404 not_found, 500 task_move_failed.

Updates a task. Every body key is optional; keys other than these are ignored.

Body: title (string, at most 255 characters, not empty once markup and whitespace are stripped), description (string), field_values (array of {field_id, value}; a field_slug sent with them is ignored).

Errors: 400 invalid_id, 400 rest_invalid_param, 400 invalid_data, 404 not_found, 500 task_update_failed.

request.description:
Lists a field's options in position order.

Errors: 400 invalid_field_id, 404 not_found (unknown field, or a field without options), 500 fetch_failed.

Lists a field's options in position order, finding the field by its slug.

Errors: 400 invalid_field_slug, 404 not_found (unknown field, or a field without options), 500 fetch_failed.

Adds an option to a field.

Body: label (required, at most 255 characters), slug (optional; letters, digits, - and _; at most 255; made from the label when left out), color (optional, #rgb or #rrggbb), position (optional integer).

Errors: 400 invalid_field_id, 400 invalid_data, 400 rest_invalid_param (label or color not a string, or position not an integer), 500 creation_failed.

Updates an option. Every body key is optional, with the same rules as when creating one. The option stays on its field. position is stored as given and the other options do not shift; use Reorder field options to reorder.

Body: label, slug, color, position.

Errors: 400 invalid_field_id, 400 invalid_option_id, 400 invalid_data, 400 rest_invalid_param (label or color not a string, or position not an integer), 404 not_found (no such option on that field), 500 update_failed.

Deletes an option. No body.

Errors: 400 invalid_field_id, 400 invalid_option_id, 404 not_found, 409 delete_failed (the option is in use or holds a status role), 500 deletion_failed.

Sets the order of a field's options.

Body: ordered_option_ids (required array listing every option of the field exactly once, in the new order).

Errors: 400 invalid_field_id, 400 rest_missing_callback_param, 400 rest_invalid_param (empty list), 400 invalid_data (unknown field, or a list that is incomplete, repeats an ID or holds another field's option), 500 update_failed.

request.description:
Returns one custom order status.

Errors: 400 invalid_id, 404 not_found.

Deletes a custom order status. No body. While orders still have the status, it is marked is_deleting and its orders move to on-hold in the background before it goes: 202, also when its deletion was already under way. A status no order has is deleted at once: 200.

Errors: 400 invalid_id, 404 not_found, 500 deletion_failed.

response.name: Delete status with orders (scheduled)

request.description:
Creates a custom order status.

Body: label (required, at most 255 characters), status_key (optional; letters, digits, - and _; at most 64; made from the label when left out), background and foreground (optional, #rgb or #rrggbb). foreground is not stored; it is worked out from background.

Errors: 400 invalid_data, 500 creation_failed.

Updates a custom order status. Every body key is optional, with the same rules as when creating one, and none may be null.

Body: label, status_key, background, foreground. status_key is stored lowercase and must not be another status's key. foreground is not stored; it is worked out from background.

Errors: 400 invalid_id, 400 invalid_data, 404 not_found, 409 status_key_taken, 500 update_failed.
